annotations.title: Swap or replace a component instance

description: Swaps or replaces a component instance's underlying component. mode="swap" (default) preserves the instance's overrides (text, variants) — use when switching to a close variant of the same component. mode="replace" removes the instance and creates a fresh one at the same position — use when swapping to an unrelated component where old overrides would be invalid. Params: nodeId (required), newComponentKey (required), mode ("swap"|"replace", default "swap"). Requires Phase 2.

mode.description: "swap" preserves overrides (default). "replace" creates a fresh instance at the same position.

newComponentKey.description: New component key to swap/replace to.

name: figma_swap_main_component
